section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of weight discrepancy using the Photographic Figure Rating Scale (PFRS) in Malaysian women. Women selected figures representing their current body and ideal body on a 10-point scale, with discrepancy computed as the absolute difference between ratings. Men did not complete the PFRS as no male version was available. Table 1 presents the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) items in English and Malay with associated factor loadings for both women and men participants.
